title: Live eval passes the task output schema to providers (escaped defect from S5-AI-03)
story: As the AI director I want the live evaluation to call providers exactly as the production cascade does so that live scores measure the models, not a harness bug
acceptance: Live run on 2026-10-19 (orchestrator): every Gemini call returned invalid_output because eval-live.mjs:336 calls wrapped.run without schema; the cascade passes schema: schemaFor(task) (cascade.mjs:121,153). eval-live passes the same options the cascade does (schema, tier, model)

A unit test uses a fake provider that returns a schema-shaped envelope only when opts.schema is present (and garbage otherwise), and asserts eval-live scores it as valid; the test fails on the old code
brief: One-line fix plus a test that would have caught it. Do not touch guardrails.mjs (S5-AI-08 runs in parallel).

verdicts.reason: Schema passed with tier/model as cascade does; regression test fails on old code (16/1) and 23 tests pass with fix
